notes: CONFORMS (2026-11-21, kb/Work PB5889, the controller's ruling; PB5886 and PB5891 before it): §2023:15.3 AR6 'An arithmetic expression that will always result in an integer value or an integer data item shall be specified' (cite.py OK). The rule is on the program and sets no method of proof; a form that always results in an integer must be accepted (§2023:4.2.2), and detecting a breach is the implementor's ('it is left to the implementor's discretion to determine what is syntactically distinguishable'). The type 6 screen (IntegerViolation's expression arm, ClassifyTypeSix; docs/INTRINSICS_DESIGN.md, the type-6 intake) has THREE outcomes. PROVEN: the polynomial proof (Build, Intermediate, SameTerm; Polynomial.FractionDigits, the grid {0..d_i}, cap degree 12 and 4096 points; every intermediate exact on the lane the code generator evaluates it on): N * (N + 1) / 2, SQRT (N) - SQRT (N) + 5, WN / 2 * 2, S * 10 are accepted, and IsAlwaysIntegral reads only this outcome for the type tables. REFUTED (COBOL1627): Refutation evaluates the exact value at points of the operands, the fixed-point items (k + 1 consecutive values of each least unit, negatives for a signed item) and floating-point items (steps of 0.5), integer terms (an integer function, a counter register, an index-name) kept as polynomial atoms and refuted only when the value is a non-integer constant plus an integer part; two or more operands must hold storage of their own, and two references to one item must be constant elements: N / 2, N * (N + 1) / 3, N ** M (M = -1), A / B, WS-F + 1, I2 + 0.5 + FUNCTION INTEGER (S2), T (1) - T (2) + 1 are refused with the value named. UNDECIDED: accepted, and the value is checked at run time (IntrinsicRenderer.UndecidedIntegerSite, CobolIntrinsics.CheckedIntegerArgument*: EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION from 2002, §2023:15.3 AR14; run-unit termination at 85): S2 - FUNCTION MAX (S2), FUNCTION MEAN (N, N) + 1, FUNCTION ORD (A) / 2 (a function's value is no value of the operands), a quotient by a function, WN / 3 * 3, and the STANDARD-DECIMAL and SDIDI roundings. Witnesses: pb5889_function_meaning_identities, pb5889_run_time_check_85, pb5889_run_time_check, pb5889_run_time_check_unchecked, the pb5886-*, pb5891-*, pb4757-*, pb4795-*, pb4796-*, pb5208-* and pb5832-* cases (refused, accepted or checked as docs/INTRINSICS_DESIGN.md lists), the complements pb5891_polynomial_integer_arguments, pb5891_standard_decimal_identity, pb5886_integer_term_shapes, pb5832_scaled_integral_shapes, pb124_always_integral_zoo, pb617_integer_arg_literal_constant, and the unit tables IntrinsicTypeSixPowerShapesDriftTests (proven, refuted or checked, read from the diagnostics and the emitted C#), IntegerArgumentConstantWitnessTests, ArgumentPolynomialTests and IntrinsicValueSourceDriftTests. retired-witness: conformance:cases/15.3-Arguments/pb5889-identity-difference (kb/Work PB5891: the type 6 classifier decides by a polynomial normal form;
